mechanic.name: Bounty: Nimble Dodge
mechanic.desc: During each round of bullet volleys or coordinated water sprays from the Fresh-Keeper Octopus, successfully dodging grants 675 Technique Score, up to 8 times, totaling 5400 points.
mechanic.descCN: 每轮「保鲜八爪」进行子弹齐射或协同喷水时，成功完成躲避即获得675技巧得分，最多触发8次，共计5400分

mechanic.name: Shell-Breaking Pursuit
mechanic.desc: When a Support Trekker deals Ultimate DMG to the boss target, the boss target's Ultimate DMG Taken intensified by 3.75% for 4s, stacking up to 10 times.
mechanic.descCN: 援护角色对首领目标造成绝招伤害时，首领目标受到的绝招伤害强度提升

mechanic.name: Bounty: Blower Bane
mechanic.descCN: 每当首领敌人释放附带「龙卷风」的技能期间，不被龙卷风命中可获得540技巧得分，最多触发10次
